findings.title: Health is marked draining but the server is shut down immediately, so balancers cannot observe the unhealthy state before connections are refused
findings.evidence: The signal path sets the draining flag and then immediately calls Shutdown on the same server, which closes listeners right away. That makes '/healthz' unreachable almost immediately after it starts returning 503, so external health checkers typically never get a chance to observe the unhealthy state and stop routing before new connections are refused.
findings.recommendation: After setting the draining flag, wait for a configurable drain period long enough for at least one health-check interval before calling 'srv.Shutdown', or separate readiness from the serving listener so health checks can continue to observe the unhealthy state during the drain window.
